image.prompt: A portrait printed garage-sale poster in a 2:3 aspect ratio, shown straight-on at eye level as a full-bleed graphic with crisp edges and no surrounding wall or frame. Bright safety orange dominates the background, paired with warm cream and deep black, with subtle uncoated-paper grain and slightly imperfect screen-printed ink textures. The focal point is an oversized cream price tag angled gently clockwise across the upper two-thirds, with a punched black hole and a looping black string curling toward the top edge. Inside the tag, the exact headline “Garage Sale” appears in massive black bold condensed display lettering, stacked on two lines, with tight spacing and confident, playful proportions. Beneath the tag, “Saturday 9am” sits prominently in cream heavy sans-serif lettering across a solid black horizontal band spanning the lower middle. At the bottom, “14 Elm St” appears in black clear bold sans-serif, generously spaced within a cream rectangular address panel. Small blank orange and cream price-tag silhouettes and black starburst accents punctuate the outer corners without competing with the typography. Flat, even neutral illumination preserves saturated colours, sharp legibility, and tactile matte-paper detail, with no directional shadows. The only visible text is “Garage Sale”, “Saturday 9am”, and “14 Elm St”.
